company.description: InSoma Bio integrates biology and materials science to solve problems in tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. It offers genetically engineer protein-based materials that can mimic the naturally found elastin found in extracellular tissues. The company also offers reconstructive plastic surgeries and injectable materials.

aiResearchSummary.text: InSoma Bio is engaged in developing fully defined matrices for organoid culture, as described in the title 'Fully defined matrices for organoid culture.' The abstract details a composition for three-dimensional cell and organoid culture, utilizing a phase-changing matrix with partially ordered polypeptides and encapsulated cells. This work highlights research and development in advanced biomaterials for tissue engineering and regenerative medicine.
